Supreme Court Questions UAPA Application in Uttarakhand Police Station Arson Case

The Supreme Court questioned the Uttarakhand government on why the stringent Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act (UAPA) was invoked in a case where a mob allegedly burnt a police station. The court asked how the UAPA is attracted solely based on the burning of a police station. This query was made during the hearing of a case concerning the application of the UAPA in Uttarakhand.
